observation_source: Owner photo, transcribed by the agent; register strings read directly from the panic screen.
panic_text: T970 UFS publish: handoff refused: firmware handoff state changed
interpretation: CB0 is the active translation (0x100ff/0x1/0xe0) and GFSR is zero, so the SMMU is not globally faulted.
The two SID entries the survey's healthy() expected are absent (0x954/0x958 read zero): they were written by the survey's own NOP test, not left by firmware.
CB0 FSR=0x400 is a pre-existing fault record, not a new one; requiring zero rejected a state the survey had already read through.
Conclusion: the snapshot gate was wrong, not the transport. Publication still not reached and no window was published.
